title: UAE Logistics Brief
lede: Iran's IRGC Navy says three more tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, two of them under US air escort, as attacks run at the highest level of the war. In the air, Dubai to Europe rates are now 97% above last year while Dubai to Europe tonnage is down 67%.

stories.headline: IRGC says three more tankers hit mines in Hormuz, two under US escort
body: Iranian state media reported on Monday evening that the IRGC Navy said three oil tankers struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz over several hours, causing explosions and fires. It said one was near the southern coast and two were east of the strait under US military air escort.
The IRGC warned that ships ignoring its instructions would be treated as cooperating with the US. The claims could not be independently verified.
stories.soWhat: New since yesterday: the US-escorted route is now being hit too. Do not sell escorted sailings to customers as safe.

stories.headline: Hormuz attacks at their highest level since the war began
body: UKMTO counted 31 attacks in and around the strait in October and about 19 in November up to 18 November, against 53 from March to September. Most attacked ships were in the southern strait, near the Omani coast.
The IMO has tallied 138 attacks on vessels across the Middle East since the war began. Iran attacked Oman's Didamar island in the strait on 8 November.
stories.soWhat: The risk now sits on the Omani side, not only off Iran. Keep war-risk and rerouting costs in every Gulf sea quote.

stories.headline: East-coast ports feed 3,500 TEU a day into Jebel Ali, but queues are long
body: Fujairah, Khor Fakkan and Dibba now send about 3,500 TEU a day to Jebel Ali, up 30% in the third quarter alone. DP World has moved more than 1 million TEU from the east coast to Jebel Ali since the war began.
Ships wait about 9 days for a berth off Fujairah, plus about 15 days to clear containers from the dock. Duqm waits were about 3 days at the end of October, and Salalah waits are measured in hours.
stories.soWhat: East-coast road legs are now the main import route into Dubai. Oman ports can be faster; price both and let customers choose.
stories.imageCredit: Abudullah Al Maani / CC BY-SA 4.0 via Maritime Executive

stories.headline: Dubai to Europe air rates now 97% above last year as tonnage falls
body: WorldACD says the global average air rate rose 2% in week 46 (9–15 November) to $3.49 per kg, the seventh weekly rise in a row and 32% above last year. Middle East and South Asia rates eased 1% on the week but are still 62% above last year.
From Dubai, rates to Europe are up 97% on last year and to the US up 88%. Dubai to Europe tonnage is down 67% on last year, and Dubai to US tonnage fell 40% in the week.
stories.soWhat: New since yesterday: the Dubai–Europe gap widened from 83% to 97%. High rates with falling tonnage means every kilo we fly needs today's price.

stories.headline: Saudi flights stay cut: Etihad to 30 November, flydubai to 27 November
body: Etihad has cancelled all Abu Dhabi–Riyadh and Abu Dhabi–Dammam flights, passenger and cargo, through 30 November. flydubai has extended Riyadh and Abha cancellations to 27 November, and Dammam runs on a reduced schedule.
Houthis claimed a strike on Saudi Arabia's Rabigh refinery on Monday; Saudi authorities did not confirm it. Lufthansa, SWISS and Eurowings restore Dubai flights from 25 November.
stories.soWhat: UAE–Saudi air stays thin for another week. Road is the default for Riyadh and Dammam until December.

stories.headline: Dubai Taxi's delivery-bike fleet tops 4,000, up 77% in a year
body: Dubai Taxi Company says its delivery-bike fleet passed 4,000 bikes by September, up 77.45% on last year, and completed over 900,000 deliveries that month. Delivery-bike revenue rose 53.1% in Q2 to AED 27.9 million.
The RTA has widened its e-bike delivery pilot from four areas to 11 locations.
stories.soWhat: Rider capacity in Dubai is growing fast. In sale weeks we can rent riders rather than add fixed headcount.

competitors.name: Emirates SkyCargo
competitors.headline: MoU with Virgin Atlantic Cargo to widen block space and interline
body: Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo signed an MoU to explore larger block space agreements and interline deals. Emirates gains reach into the Americas, and Virgin into the Middle East and Asia.
For the first time the two will interline active pharma shipments. They carried a combined 2,000 tonnes in the first half of 2026.
competitors.soWhat: Emirates is locking in Dubai–UK–US capacity while Dubai–US rates are up 88%. We should secure our own BSAs on that lane now.

competitors.name: DHL
competitors.headline: Builds up on the UAE east coast; keeps €500m Gulf plan
body: DHL Global Forwarding is strengthening its position near Khor Fakkan, Dibba and Fujairah. Its €500 million Gulf commitment is unchanged, after facilities worth €120 million in the UAE and €130 million in Saudi Arabia, and it has a 20-year Etihad Rail joint venture.
MEA CEO Tobias Maier expects freight to normalise three to six months after the conflict ends.
competitors.soWhat: DHL is going where today's cargo lands. Our east-coast ground and warehouse offer needs to be visible to key accounts.

competitors.name: Aramex (baseline)
competitors.headline: Data Center Logistics launched; Q3 revenue a record Dh1.98bn
body: Aramex Data Center Logistics covers transformers, chillers, generators and AI racks across the GCC, Southeast Asia, Taiwan and the southern US, by charter and secure road. Emirates SkyCargo launched a rival AI Tech air product the same day.
Latest results: Q3 net profit Dh48 million on record revenue of Dh1.98 billion.
competitors.soWhat: Emirates now competes for the same AI hardware flows. Our edge is door-to-hall delivery and road, not just the air leg.

opportunities.title: Dubai–Europe air yield
opportunities.text: Rates are 97% above last year. Spot quotes on Dubai–Europe can carry the market price.

opportunities.title: East-coast port drayage
opportunities.text: 3,500 TEU a day move from Fujairah, Khor Fakkan and Dibba to Jebel Ali. Sell scheduled trucking and dock clearance on that leg.

opportunities.title: Oman ports as the faster gate
opportunities.text: Salalah waits are hours and Duqm about 3 days, against 9 days off Fujairah. Offer an Oman-gate import option into the UAE.

opportunities.title: UAE–Saudi road
opportunities.text: Etihad and flydubai Saudi cuts run to 27–30 November. Push road express for Riyadh and Dammam.

opportunities.title: AI data centre cargo
opportunities.text: Emirates and Aramex both launched AI hardware products. Target GCC data centre builders before others lock them in.

watchouts.title: Escorted ships hit too
watchouts.text: Iran says two of Monday's tankers were under US escort. Escort is no longer a safe-route argument.

watchouts.title: Dubai air tonnage falling
watchouts.text: Dubai–Europe tonnage is down 67% on last year. High rates may not offset lost volume in forwarding.

watchouts.title: Fujairah congestion
watchouts.text: 9-day berth waits plus 15 days to clear the dock. Customer delivery promises must include that time.

watchouts.title: Saudi attacks
watchouts.text: Houthis claim a strike on Saudi's Rabigh refinery. Saudi road and air routes could be cut further.

watchouts.title: Competitors buying capacity
watchouts.text: Emirates–Virgin block space and DHL's east-coast build-up may take capacity before we do.

moves.title: Reprice Dubai–Europe spot air daily
moves.text: Move the Dubai–Europe spot card toward week 46 levels (+97% on last year) and review it each morning.

moves.title: Package east-coast drayage
moves.text: Price a scheduled Fujairah/Khor Fakkan to Jebel Ali truck and dock-clearance service and send it to sea-import accounts.

moves.title: Add an Oman-gate option
moves.text: Quote Salalah or Duqm plus road into the UAE as an alternative to Fujairah for customers facing long waits.

moves.title: Push road express to Saudi
moves.text: Tell UAE shippers that Etihad and flydubai Saudi cuts run to 27–30 November and offer road express to Riyadh and Dammam.

moves.title: Secure Dubai–US block space
moves.text: Open BSA talks for December on Dubai–US before Emirates–Virgin capacity tightens the lane.

moves.title: Pitch Data Center Logistics
moves.text: List the top GCC data centre projects and pitch door-to-hall delivery against Emirates AI Tech.
